Here is a recap of what happened in the search forums today, through the eyes of the Search Engine Roundtable and other search forums on the web.
Google is testing new AI Overview citation cards that are more visible and click-worthy. Microsoft Advertising released its biggest bidding update in a decade. Google Ads help documents on AI Max for Search for Travel campaigns. Google Ads has added two features to the Performance Max campaign set up screen for Channel Prioritization and Promo Mode. Google will migrate hotel campaigns to travel campaigns. New Google Ads Commercial exceptions to US Election Ads poliocy. Google tag and Tag Manager unification has begun. Google AdSense has new regulatory documents.
Search Engine Roundtable Stories:
-
Google AI Overviews With Unfaded Citation Block
Google seems to have rolled out an update to the AI Overviews on the Google Search page where the citation cards or blocks on the right side are not faded out. Instead, the citations are fully visible, and you don't need to click into the AI Overview to view them fully. -
Microsoft Advertising Announces Biggest Upgrade To Bidding Models
Microsoft announced the "biggest upgrade" to bidding models in a decade within Microsoft Advertising. Microsoft wrote, "we're continuously listening to customer feedback to understand the ways we can make our bidding deliver better results for advertisers, and now we're rolling out the biggest upgrade to bidding models in a decade." -
Google Tag & Google Tag Manager Unification
This past August, Google announced the unification of Google tag and Google Tag Manager. Well, today Google posted a Google Tag Manager release not about the unification. It is titled Google tag and Google Tag Manager unification and dated on November 17, 2026. -
Google Hotel Campaigns Migrating To Search Campaigns For Travel
While Google is migrating travel campaigns to the Search campaigns for Travel now, Google will be migrating Hotel campaigns will or is migrating to new Search campaigns for Travel this quarter, Q4 2026. -
Google Ads Releases Several AI Max For Search For Travel Campaigns Help Docs
Google has released several new Google Ads help documents on the topic of AI Max for Search for Travel campaigns. This comes as Google begins to migrate Travel campaigns to the new Search campaigns for Travel in Google Ads. -
Google Ads New Commercial Exemptions To US Election Advertising Policy
Google Ads has added a new exemption to its political content policy for "Commercial exceptions to US Election Ads." This essentially exempts ads that feature candidates solely for government programs or commercial products, without political references, from US Election Ads verification. -
Google Ads PMax Setup Now With Channel Prioritization & Promo Mode
Google Ads has added two features to the Performance Max campaign set up screen for Channel Prioritization and Promo Mode. While Channel Prioritization and Promo Mode are not new, it is reportedly new within this campaign set up screen. -
Google AdSense Opt-Out, Messaging & Privacy Updates
Google AdSense posted a few updates related to regulatory changes around opt-out controls, messaging and privacy regulations for the ad product. I figured I'd group them into one post and sum it up. -
Android Figurine With Smart Glasses?
Here is another photo from the Android Dev Summit in London. This one shows off a big green Android figurine wearing what looks like smart glasses.
